Primary_Source_Organization_Reviewed: Sharjah Ports, Customs & Free Zones Authority
Primary_Source_Title_Reviewed: Sharjah Ports Authority Tariff — Port Regulations, Approaches
Primary_Source_Exact_Evidence: The official tariff distinguishes Port Khalid, Port Khorfakkan and Hamriyah Port. It gives the Port Khalid fairway buoy position as 25°22.9'N, 55°20.8'E. This is an approach buoy, not a port reference coordinate.
Primary_Source_Reference_Point: Port Khalid fairway buoy; navigational approach reference only
Secondary_Source_Exact_Evidence: Cogoport associates port code AESHJ with Sharjah (KHALID) / Port Khalid and lists 25°21'0N, 55°22'0E.
Secondary_Source_Reference_Point: Secondary Port Khalid location point; exact physical reference point unspecified
Coordinate_Conflict_Description: Sharjah Ports Authority confirms three separate ports and gives the Port Khalid fairway buoy at 25.381667,55.346667. Cogoport associates AESHJ with Port Khalid and gives a port location point at 25.350000,55.366667. The points represent different reference objects and must not be treated as conflicting measurements of the same point. The fairway buoy is not a port coordinate.
Researcher_Evidence_Conclusion: Sharjah Ports Authority establishes that Port Khalid is one of three distinct ports under its authority and publishes the Port Khalid fairway buoy position at 25.381667,55.346667. This is a navigational approach reference, not a port coordinate. Cogoport associates AESHJ with Port Khalid and publishes a secondary port-location point at 25.350000,55.366667. The association is useful but requires confirmation against the UN/LOCODE source record and exact source-call facility. Retain the secondary point as a candidate only; do not use the buoy coordinate as a port or terminal coordinate.

Primary_Source_Title_Reviewed: ICTSI Factbook — Basra Gateway Terminal, Umm Qasr, Iraq
Primary_Source_Exact_Evidence: ICTSI Factbook identifies Basra Gateway Terminal at Umm Qasr and publishes terminal location latitude 30.0558097 and longitude 47.9255077. It describes terminal infrastructure including east and west terminal areas and berths.
Primary_Source_Reference_Point: Basra Gateway Terminal location; terminal-specific, not whole Umm Qasr port
Secondary_Source_Exact_Evidence: BMTIQ identifies Basra Multi-Purpose Terminal in Umm Qasr North Port, gives terminal UN location code IQ UQR and terminal coordinates 30°02'N, 47°57'E.
Coordinate_Conflict_Description: ICTSI's Basra Gateway Terminal is at 30.0558097,47.9255077. BMTIQ separately identifies Basra Multi-Purpose Terminal in Umm Qasr North Port and gives 30.033333,47.950000. These are different terminals, not conflicting coordinates for one point. The whole Umm Qasr port system contains multiple terminals and port areas; source-call terminal identity remains unresolved.
Researcher_Evidence_Conclusion: ICTSI publishes a location for Basra Gateway Terminal at 30.0558097,47.9255077. BMTIQ separately identifies Basra Multi-Purpose Terminal under UN location code IQ UQR and publishes 30.033333,47.950000. Both are terminal-level references within Umm Qasr, not interchangeable coordinates for the whole port. Retain both as facility-specific candidates. Do not select either as the IQUQR port coordinate until source-call terminal mapping is established.

Primary_Source_Title_Reviewed: Port of Karachi — Port Information Manual, Revision 0
Primary_Source_Exact_Evidence: The KPT manual describes Keamari as a small town on a sand ridge east of the southern part of East Wharf. It separately identifies Upper Harbour at approximately 24°49.80'N, 66°58.50'E and describes East Wharf, West Wharf and multiple terminals.
Primary_Source_Reference_Point: Upper Harbour reference point; not a Kiamari locality point or individual terminal
Secondary_Source_Exact_Evidence: SeaLagom lists UN/LOCODE PK KIA for Kiamari and coordinates 24°49.0'N, 066°58.0'E (24.816667,66.966667), describing Kiamari as the harbour district of Port of Karachi.
Coordinate_Conflict_Description: KPT's Upper Harbour reference at 24.830000,66.975000 is a harbour feature, while SeaLagom's 24.816667,66.966667 is a Kiamari locality/port-guide point. KPT describes Keamari's relationship to East Wharf but does not publish a single Kiamari coordinate in the reviewed passage. The port contains multiple wharves, berths and terminals. Do not treat the two points as competing measurements of the same object.
Researcher_Evidence_Conclusion: Karachi Port Trust's Port Information Manual describes Keamari's geographic relationship to East Wharf and separately publishes the Upper Harbour reference at 24.830000,66.975000. SeaLagom lists PKKIA/Kiamari at 24.816667,66.966667, but this is secondary directory evidence. The KPT Upper Harbour point is not a Kiamari coordinate, and neither point identifies a specific terminal or berth. Retain both with their distinct scopes; source-call facility attribution and an authoritative Kiamari reference point remain unresolved.

Primary_Source_Title_Reviewed: MIC Port Information and Regulations Guide, January 2021 — Berth and Terminal Information
Primary_Source_Exact_Evidence: The Mesaieed Port Guide lists QAPCO at Berths 17 and 18, with berth length and depth information. The guide establishes QAPCO as a berth/terminal user within the shared Mesaieed Port system but does not publish a QAPCO-specific coordinate in the reviewed berth table.
Primary_Source_Reference_Point: QAPCO berths 17 and 18 within Mesaieed Port; no coordinate supplied in reviewed table
Secondary_Source_Title_Reviewed: Qatar Petrochemical Company Mesaieed Chemical Plant 1
Secondary_Source_Exact_Evidence: Global Energy Monitor lists the QAPCO chemical plant in Mesaieed at WGS84 coordinates 24.929436,51.566042.
Secondary_Source_Reference_Point: QAPCO chemical plant location; not a jetty, berth or vessel loading point
Coordinate_Conflict_Description: QatarEnergy's Mesaieed Port Guide identifies QAPCO at Berths 17 and 18 but does not publish a QAPCO-specific coordinate in the reviewed table. Global Energy Monitor gives a plant location at 24.929436,51.566042. The plant location is not a berth or jetty coordinate. Mesaieed Port is a shared industrial port with multiple operators and berths; do not infer the QAPCO berth position from the plant point.
Researcher_Evidence_Conclusion: QatarEnergy's official Mesaieed Port Guide identifies QAPCO at Berths 17 and 18, establishing its berth association within the shared port system. The reviewed official guide does not give a QAPCO-specific coordinate. Global Energy Monitor lists the QAPCO chemical plant at 24.929436,51.566042, but that is a plant-location point, not a berth or vessel loading coordinate. Retain it as a secondary industrial-facility candidate only. Obtain a QAPCO/operator or port-authority berth plan before assigning a terminal or berth coordinate.
